description: Defines the CameraController interface for handling and sending messages related to camera control in a WebRTC context within the cuttlefish project.

classes.name: CameraController
classes.description: An abstract interface for handling camera-related messages and communication in the WebRTC frontend component.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle data messages from the client, accepting a vector of characters.

methods.name: HandleMessage
methods.description: Pure virtual method to handle control messages from the client, accepting a Json::Value.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a control message to the client using a stored message sender function.

methods.name: SetMessageSender
methods.description: Sets the function used to send messages to the client.
